overview: The National Waterway Development – IWAI Schemes focus on the development and regulation of inland waterways for shipping and navigation in India. The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI), established in 1986, undertakes projects for development and maintenance of IWT infrastructure on national waterways through grants received from the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways. IWAI has developed 111 National Waterways (NWs) across India, with a total length of 20,187 km, and promotes inland water transport (IWT) through infrastructure development, navigational aids, and schemes like the Cargo Promotion Scheme to incentivize modal shift from road and rail to IWT.
objectives: Development and regulation of inland waterways for shipping and navigation
Undertake projects for development and maintenance of IWT infrastructure on national waterways
Promote modal shift of cargo from road and rail to inland water transport (IWT)
Develop and maintain navigational channels through dredging and bandalling
Establish terminals, jetties, and allied infrastructure on National Waterways
Facilitate cargo and passenger movement on Indo-Bangladesh Protocol (IBP) route
Support river cruise tourism and develop operational stretches on National Waterways
Provide Least Available Depth (LAD) data for safe navigation
eligibility: Eligibility varies by sub-scheme. For the Cargo Promotion Scheme, cargo owners shifting cargo from rail/road to IWT on NW-1, NW-2, and NW-16 via IBP route for long-haul movements (>300 km) are eligible, excluding short-haul, Ro-Ro, Ro-Pax, ODC movements, and transport by ICSL. For internships, candidates pursuing/completed graduate/post-graduate courses from reputed institutions with minimum 75% in 12th (UG) or 60% in graduation (PG) are eligible. For deputation posts, applicants must be from Central/State Govt./PSUs/Statutory bodies with analogous posts, required qualifications, and experience as specified in individual recruitment notices.
benefits: Financial incentives of 35% of total actual operating expenditure on waterways journey for cargo owners under the Cargo Promotion Scheme. Infrastructure development including terminals, jetties, navigational aids, and fairway maintenance. Provision of Least Available Depth (LAD) data for safe navigation. Support for river cruise tourism through operational stretches and jetty development. Internship stipend of Rs. 10,000/month for undergraduates and Rs. 20,000/month for postgraduates/research scholars. Employment opportunities on deputation basis in various technical and administrative roles.
financial_support: Under the Cargo Promotion Scheme, financial incentives are provided to the extent of 35% of the total actual operating expenditure incurred on waterways journey for sustainable modal shift of cargo from road or rail to IWT. The scheme is currently proposed at a cost of less than 100 Crore for three years and can be scaled up or modified based on success. IWAI undertakes projects for development and maintenance of IWT infrastructure on national waterways through grant received from the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.
application_process: For the Cargo Promotion Scheme: 1. Register online with ICSL on a portal developed by ICSL. 2. Submit applications with details of cargo to be transported, planned route, plan for modal shift for 5 years, and other relevant information. 3. Commit to cargo volumes for 3 years for modal shift to IWT and undertake regular movements on NW-1, NW-2, NW-16 and transit movements using Indo Bangladesh Protocol routes. 4. Applications examined and approved by the Steering Committee. 5. Maintain accurate records, voyage log book, documents, and reports related to transportation via IWT. 6. Submit periodic reports detailing quantity of cargo transported, routes used, modal shift achieved, and other relevant data. 7. For fund disbursement, submit documents including Bill of coastal goods, Shipper’s Certificate, Receiver’s Certificate, Port’s Invoice, Terminals Invoice, Lock Gate charges, Vessel related expenses (fuel, manning, insurance), Customs Clearance & Immigration Documents (if applicable), and other valid invoices. 8. Funds disbursed within 7 days of receipt of all requisite documents (GST bills only). 9. All documents and payment requests submitted online. For internships: 1. Send applications along with CVs in prescribed format to The Secretary, IWAI, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201301. 2. Clearly indicate area of interest and preferred division. 3. Produce a letter from Head of Department/Principal indicating status and 'No Objection' for internship. 4. Applications processed by Recruitment and Training Cell at IWAI. 5. Applications scrutinized by Head Office/respective Directorate. 6. Actual offers sent to selected interns subject to availability of slots, consent of Division, and approval of Competent Authority.
required_documents: Bill of coastal goods signed and stamped by Master / Owner / Operator of the vessel
Shipper’s Certificate of handing over cargo for transport via IWT
Receivers Certificate of having received cargo transported through IWT
Port’s Invoice for vessel related charges (Port Dues, Berth Hire, Pilotage, Pre arrival notice, Port Clearance etc.) with date & time of vessel’s arrival and departure
Terminals Invoice for cargo handling reflecting cargo quantity loaded/discharged, handling tariff, overtime, special service charges, total amount
Log Book duly attested/signed by Master of vessel
Invoice for purchase of fuel with quantity and rate
Manning Contract & Manning Invoice for relevant period
Invoice for insurance premium for H & M cover, cargo etc.
Customs Clearance & Immigration Documents (transit permit, statutory charges, incidental expenses) for cargo movement through NW2/IBP route
Any other valid invoice & supporting documents for expenses claimed
For internships: Application form, CV, educational certificates, testimonials, letter from Head of Department/Principal with No Objection
For deputation posts: Application form, self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, last 5 years’ APARs, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round for internships and deputation posts as per periodic employment notices. For the Cargo Promotion Scheme, the scheme is initially valid for a period of 3 years.
contact_details: Email: nsingh@iwai.gov.in | Phone No. 0120-2474050 (Internship Programme contact)
caveats: The Cargo Promotion Scheme is currently restricted to NW-1, NW-2, and NW-16 via Indo Bangladesh Protocol routes
Incentives under the Cargo Promotion Scheme are not applicable for short haul movements (<300 km), Ro-Ro, Ro-Pax, ODC movements, or transport by ICSL
Financial incentives to cargo owners will not be provided beyond the period of 3 years under the Cargo Promotion Scheme
Internship duration is minimum 1 month and maximum 3 months as decided by Competent Authority, not exceeding 6 months
Interns not completing the requisite period as stipulated in their offer will not be issued with any certificate
The Internship Programme may be modified as per the requirement of IWAI with approval of the Competent Authority (Chairman, IWAI)
Internship is neither a job nor any assurance for job in IWAI
